p.i: Milesve tantum perdere principem Tentauit, eheu! sub duce Barbaro Gallus? Tyrannorumq; signa Hospita Guisiadum sequutus Funesta Gallis praelia ciuibus Impune monuit? Ruraq; feruido Sulcata Francorum labore Marte suo populata vidit? Quum sceptra Genti Gallica perfidæ, Et fraudulento prodidit hospiti: Quum iussa vellet subiugatos Francigenas Lotharinga ferre? Tali superbis milite, Guisie, Regnumq; poscis, quidlibet impotens Sperare, per vastas ruentis Dum patria furit ille cædes. Sic regna stirpi debita regiæ Galloq; captas aduena principi? Sic prisca Legum sacra turbas Et Salicæ pia iura Normæ? Te blandienti somnus imagine, Te mentis error ludit amabilis: Quum sceptra Gallorum lacertis Grandia non paribus prehensas. Qui regna terris diuidit omnibus, Qui regna firmat legibus additis Tremendus author, Gentibusque Iura dedit, violanda nulli:

page.notes: The first line reads "Milesve" with a small mark over the e that may be a printed superscript; I read it as printed. Line 1 may begin with a superscript letter in the original. Otherwise the text is clear. Stanza divisions are not visible in the layout, so the verse is given as one paragraph with its lines kept.
